data.narrative:
Tenna Systems, a Seed-stage defense and security technology company, has raised $13.5M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at Seed or Series A stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $13.5M total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $34M. Peer-median analysis draws from three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median across these three peers is $400M, establishing the upper bound of observable market pricing for this cohort.

Triangulating both methods yields a range of $29M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $217M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method is mechanically conservative given minimal financial history, while the peer-median approach is sensitive to the inclusion of UFORCE, an outlier at $1.0B. Key uncertainties include pre-launch customer traction, IP defensibility within a competitive defense-tech landscape, and the company's position relative to well-capitalized incumbents and better-funded peers.
